name: Prism
description: WebGL2 raymarched glowing pyramid prism with iridescent color bands that rotates, tilts toward the pointer, and fills its container as an animated background.
contents: Container div holding a full-size WebGL2 canvas rendering a raymarched glowing prism
behavior: Fragment shader raymarches a pyramid shape with glowing color bands, with optional palette from custom colors
Animation type rotates the prism on its Y axis, rotates it in 3D, tilts only on hover, or stays static
Prism tilts toward the pointer with inertia while the pointer is inside the container
Glow ignites with an intro fade-in on mount
Render loop pauses when offscreen, tab hidden, or nothing is animating; reduced motion disables spin, intro and tilt
Canvas resizes with the container through ResizeObserver, rendered at reduced resolution for performance
editableByProps: Prism size and shape (height, baseWidth), zoom (scale) and position (offset)
Colors through a custom palette, hueShift, saturation, colorFrequency, glow and noise grain
Animation mode, speed, pointer tilt strength, inertia and intro on or off
Light mode for use on light backgrounds, render resolution and dpr
Container className, style and extra DOM attributes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the prism shape or the raymarch look
needsCodeEdit.where: pyramid function and main in the FRAGMENT shader string

needsCodeEdit.change: Listen to pointer only on the container instead of the whole window
needsCodeEdit.where: window pointermove listener in the useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if the context or shader fails
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height
Pointer tracking is attached to the window, not the container
Settings are read live, but the WebGL setup runs once on mount
Heavy 100-step raymarch per pixel, can be costly on weak mobile GPUs; resolution defaults to 0.5 to compensate
Hover tilt has no touch equivalent; on touch devices it is just a spinning or static prism
Canvas scales with the container, so it works on mobile, tablet and desktop

options.look: Prism spins around its vertical axis with slight pointer tilt
options.useWhen: Hero background that should feel alive and continuously moving

options.look: Prism tumbles on all axes with a wobbling motion
options.useWhen: Showcase or launch hero for a tech product wanting a more dynamic 3D object

options.look: Prism stays still and tilts strongly toward the pointer
options.useWhen: Interactive section where the visitor's mouse should drive the motion and idle stays calm

options.look: Fixed prism with no spin, only subtle optional pointer tilt
options.useWhen: Behind dense text or pricing content where motion would distract
